features.label: Essential shapes
features.explanation: Keep only the key shapes needed to recognize the original subjects and remove secondary details
features.evidence: Glasses, hair, hand and clothing are simplified; a few key shapes can still suggest identity.
features.zh: 仅保留足以辨认原有主体的关键形状，删除次要细节
features.en: Keep only the key shapes needed to recognize the original subjects and remove secondary details

features.label: Precise contours
features.explanation: Make contour changes precise and clear, avoiding unnecessary outlines and decorative lines
features.evidence: The turns in the black–white boundaries are clearly defined, without additional uniform outlines.
features.zh: 让轮廓转折精确清楚，避免多余的描边与装饰线
features.en: Make contour changes precise and clear, avoiding unnecessary outlines and decorative lines

features.label: Black–white contrast
features.explanation: Use two clearly defined groups of color fields, near-black and soft white, to establish strong contrast
features.evidence: The main subject uses broad areas of near-black and soft white in contrast.
features.zh: 使用近黑与柔白两组清楚色面建立强对比
features.en: Use two clearly defined groups of color fields, near-black and soft white, to establish strong contrast

features.label: Two-part light and shadow
features.explanation: Reduce light and shadow to a few coherent shapes, avoiding gradients and complex reflections
features.evidence: Light and dark are compressed into connected color shapes, relying very little on gradients.
features.zh: 将光影归纳为少量完整形状，避免渐变与复杂反光
features.en: Reduce light and shadow to a few coherent shapes, avoiding gradients and complex reflections

features.label: Complementary positive and negative shapes
features.explanation: Keep the original spatial relationships, making the subjects and surrounding blank space form complementary shapes
features.evidence: The pale shapes of the face and hand are enclosed by broad black areas; positive and negative shapes work together to make them recognizable.
features.zh: 保持原有位置关系，让主体与周围空白形成互补形状
features.en: Keep the original spatial relationships, making the subjects and surrounding blank space form complementary shapes

features.label: Clean flat surfaces
features.explanation: Create even, clean flat color shapes without adding grain textures
features.evidence: The surface is smooth and clean, without obvious grain; this alone cannot establish the software or medium.
features.zh: 呈现均匀、干净的平面色块，不叠加颗粒纹理
features.en: Create even, clean flat color shapes without adding grain textures

features.label: Bold and restrained
features.explanation: Create a bold, restrained graphic character that can be recognized at a glance
features.evidence: Highly reduced shapes and strong contrast give the image a bold, restrained graphic character.
features.zh: 营造鲜明、克制且易于一眼辨认的图形感
features.en: Create a bold, restrained graphic character that can be recognized at a glance

features.label: Keep the source palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creating an image, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑或道具；不添加参考图的题字、署名或水印；不改变原图的动作与物件关系
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings or props absent from the source image; do not add inscriptions, signatures or watermarks from the reference; do not alter the source image’s actions or relationships between objects
